Here are some affordable 4K TV options:

1. Hisense 50-Inch Class R6 Series 4K UHD Smart Roku TV: This TV has a 50-inch screen size, 4K UHD resolution, and smart TV capabilities with Alexa compatibility. It's priced at $235.99.
2. LG UHD UQ75 Series 70” (70UQ7590PUB, 2022): This TV has a 70-inch screen size, 4K UHD resolution, and smart TV capabilities with Google Assistant and Alexa compatibility. It's priced at $549.99.
3. SAMSUNG 55-Inch Class QLED 4K Q60C Series Quantum HDR: This TV has a 55-inch screen size, 4K UHD resolution, and QLED technology with quantum HDR and dual LED. It's priced at $597.99.

These TVs offer great picture quality, smart TV capabilities, and affordable prices. However, please note that prices may vary depending on the retailer and availability.
